## #1 — dresdenwitch — 2012-03-17
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/8229/post-68590>

The Transform Tool

Is there some way where I can make the transform tool not quite so solid or smaller?

My problem is that when I click onto 'point mode' the transform tool covers the area where I want to work  eg.. can't see how far to pull it out.

Thank you :smile:

## #2 — frank beckmann — 2012-03-17
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/8229/post-68592>

You can manipulate geometry like you do in Silo; hold shift+alt keys down, hoover/click&drag when the transform-tool is in "move-mode" - so no transform-tool is visible at all.

Cheers
Frank
